records.name: intro-greeting
records.prompt: Edit the provided children's picture-book production plate, not a redesign. Input image is the exact edit target. Preserve its 16:9 framing, every object's location, scale and silhouette, the headless yellow sweater child's body at exactly the same position and proportions (leave its neck empty for later LOCAL real-photo compositing), the little girl, courtyard, tree, house, orange shoes, all original warm ochre/sage cream colours, painterly watercolour and gouache style and cream blank right-hand area. Improve only the fidelity of fine painted details: clearly resolved knit weave, natural individual leaf edges, fine grasses, little daisies, coherent stone texture, delicate paper and brush detail. Retain softness appropriate for a premium preschool illustrated book, avoid sharp photographic textures or plastic 3D. Do not enlarge the garden, do not shrink or move people, do not add a head/face above the empty neck, no new objects, no text, no borders. Match the original geometry extremely closely because this image must replace the source plate under an existing character compositor with unchanged registration. Deliver at the highest actual native resolution supported. It must look like the same illustration with more finely resolved painting, never an interpolated-looking rescale.
